behavior: A part keeps its accessible name when the consumer gives it a blank `aria-label` or a blank `aria-labelledby`: an empty string, or a string of white space only. A blank value names nothing: the accessible name computation ignores a blank `aria-label` and an `aria-labelledby` that has no valid id. The value thus counts as not given, and the part keeps its own `aria-label` and `aria-labelledby`. A wrapper that gives its optional label prop the default `''` thus keeps the name of a dialog, of a menu and of a checkbox that a `<label>` names. `null` removes the value of the part (`VUE-103`). In Base UI, a blank value replaces the value of the part, and the element loses the name that the part gives. Base UI ignores a blank value only for the `aria-label` of a control that a label names. `Meter.Root` gives a blank value to its element as it is.
